The matter is urgent, please call: [phone]. Regards, Monika

english: Good morning, uh, I am looking for a plot, the kind for building our own house, not for sale, for us... in San Pedro or Guadalmina, or possibly Cancelada, so that it is close to the school... the budget for the land itself is about four hundred, five hundred thousand... we would like to buy in the coming months, because the architect is already waiting... so please send some proposals, thanks

Essentially, we are the construction company RemontSol, we do full turnkey renovations before sale (kitchens, bathrooms, floors, electrical), and we would like to offer your clients a 10% discount upon your recommendation. For you — 5% from each order. I am attaching examples of work and agency reviews. When is it convenient to call? Artur, RemontSol

Svetlana

Best regards, Per Åkesson, Åkesson Bygg AB

english: I am interested in object 7730, the penthouse in Guadalmina Baja. Is it still for sale and what is the lowest price? We can pay cash and have time to see it next week. Tel [phone]

source: Hej, Vi vill lista vår villa i Mijas Pueblo (4 sovrum, 2 500 m² tomt, pool) hos er. Vi har redan en värdering från banken på 790 000 € och vill gå ut med ett pris nära det. Tänkt start: efter nyår, så vi hinner fixa trädgården. Vi bor i villan permanent. Med vänlig hälsning, Göran och Elisabeth Sundin
english: Hi, We want to list our villa in Mijas Pueblo (4 bedrooms, 2 500 m² plot, pool) with you. We already have a valuation from the bank at 790 000 € and want to go out with a price close to that. Planned start: after New Year, so we have time to fix up the garden. We live in the villa permanently. Best regards, Göran and Elisabeth Sundin

source: Hej! Vi säljer och monterar luftvärmepumpar och solceller på hela Costa del Sol, svensktalande montörer. Era kunder behöver oss efter köpet 😉 Skicka gärna vidare till era köpare, vi ger er 5% på varje affär. /Niklas, SolSyd
english: Hi! We sell and install air source heat pumps and solar cells throughout Costa del Sol, Swedish-speaking installers. Your customers need us after the purchase 😉 Please feel free to forward to your buyers, we give you 5% on every deal. /Niklas, SolSyd

source: Hej! Vi bor i Stockholm och letar efter en lägenhet i Nueva Andalucía, 2 sovrum, nära golfen. Budget runt 450 000 €. Vi kommer ner i december och vill gärna se några objekt då. Mvh Karin o Peter
english: Hi! We live in Stockholm and are looking for an apartment in Nueva Andalucía, 2 bedrooms, near the golf. Budget around 450 000 €. We are coming down in December and would like to see some properties then. Best regards Karin o Peter

source: Hej, det är Robert, jag har en lägenhet i Benalmádena, eh, Arroyo de la Miel, en tvåa, och jag undrar bara vad den skulle vara värd idag, jag köpte 2019 och priserna har ju gått upp en del. Inte för att sälja, mer för att veta var jag står. Ring gärna tillbaka när ni har tid. Tack, hej.
english: Hi, it's Robert, I have an apartment in Benalmádena, uh, Arroyo de la Miel, a two-room, and I'm just wondering what it would be worth today, I bought in 2019 and prices have gone up quite a bit. Not to sell, more to know where I stand. Please call me back when you have time. Thanks, bye.
